Chapter 600: Chapter 31: Founding the Martial Realm (Please Subscribe)

Longshan Ling.

Outside the Longshan Great Hall.

Many members of the Longshan Family were likewise gazing at the dark, lightless sky.

Once, that was where the eternal Divine Kingdom of the gods resided, revered by all beings.

“How do I feel that the Patriarch is still alive? The bloodline still exists?” a core member of the Longshan Family couldn’t help but say.

In this world, numerous Knight cultivation skills, and even the Martial Tao Cultivation Skill indigenous to Lin Yuan, are all centered around the bloodline.

...

Essentially, they are all about constantly exploring the ultimate potential of the bloodline.

In the face of drastically shortening lifespans, comprehending external laws? The efficiency is too slow.

Only by relying on the innate potential of one’s own bloodline could one hope to ignite the divine fire before a thousand years, ascend to the rank of Seventh Layer Demigod, and then plot to uplift a Divine Kingdom.

Therefore—

The powers of this world are extremely sensitive to bloodline perception, especially towards clan members sharing the same bloodline.

As the strongest individual and Patriarch of the Longshan Family, Lin Yuan, although many clan members could not specifically sense Lin Yuan’s bloodline,

the fall of such an existence, the extinction of the bloodline, would be felt by all members of the Longshan Family, causing a sorrow that emanated from the depths of their bloodline.

But up to now, all members of the Longshan Family had not felt such a sensation, especially Lin Yuan’s parents, the Longshan Fang Couple.

They also did not sense their son’s death.

“The Patriarch isn’t dead?” Many members of the Longshan Family widened their eyes, some unable to react.

They had witnessed their Patriarch entering the Ocean of Light, and now with such a great event occurring in the abode of the gods, with the gods perishing, their Patriarch was still alive?

It wasn’t that they wished for the Patriarch to die, but with the gods almost all dead, and the Prime God nearly extinct, the Patriarch also being in the Ocean of Light, how could it be that nothing at all had happened to him?

Even though many members of the Longshan Family had an almost blind faith in their Patriarch, they never arrogantly believed that the Patriarch’s strength was greater than that of all the other gods and the Prime God combined.

“Unless…” A few elderly members of the Longshan Family’s complexions slightly shifted, a dreadful guess faintly surfacing in their hearts.

This guess was incredibly unbelievable, but did the unforeseen events unfolding fit only this inconceivable guess?

Longshan Ling and a few other trusted subordinates of the clan leaders exchanged glances, the same conjecture emerging in their minds.

That is, the horrifying scene causing this twilight of the gods before them, was it related to their Patriarch?

Or to put it plainly, was it done by their Patriarch himself?

This conjecture was supported by two pieces of evidence.

First, the swift downfall of the gods began right after the Patriarch entered the Ocean of Light.

An occurrence never seen in eons happening just as the Patriarch went in?

If it were just this, everyone might not be suspicious and at most feel that their Patriarch was unlucky.

But up till now, the Patriarch’s bloodline had not perished and was still very much alive, in stark contrast with the dark and desolate sky.

“Is the Patriarch, slaughtering the gods?” The souls of Longshan Ling and other trusted subordinates trembled, many of them having witnessed Lin Yuan’s growth.

Over hundreds of years, Lin Yuan had created countless myths, even effortlessly breaking free from the bloodline shackles of the first generation Baron Longshan, becoming the first Seventh Rank Demigod in the history of the Longshan Family.

However, no matter what, one couldn’t possibly overthrow the gods with individual power, could they?

“Let’s wait for the Patriarch to return, then we can ask him,” Longshan Ling inhaled deeply, although after eliminating all other possibilities,

the remaining implausible possibility no matter how fantastical, was nevertheless the truth.

But without the Patriarch’s personal confirmation, they were still somewhat incredulous.

…

Deep within the numerous Spatial Layers.

Lin Yuan was strolling leisurely, quickly closing the distance on the Spatial Layers with the figure frantically fleeing ahead.

“Prime God of Light.”

Lin Yuan looked towards the last remaining Prime God.

He was the first Prime God born of this world, and also the most powerful among the twenty-four Prime Gods.

Throughout the long years, the Dark God fought against him and mostly emerged the loser.

“Longshan Patriarch, you are not a Supreme God, you are definitely not a Supreme God,” the Prime God of Light despaired internally, continually breaking through layers of space, trying to reach the deepest region of this world’s space.

“Whether I am a Supreme God or not has no significance as to whether you can survive,” Lin Yuan said calmly.

Previously, the Prime God of Light had summoned the other twenty-three Prime Gods and many True Gods, trying to suppress Lin Yuan and seize what they believed to be the chance of the Supreme God, with no mercy shown.

If it hadn’t been for Lin Yuan’s strength being formidable enough, had he encountered the assault of the Prime God of Light during his Seventh or Eighth Layer period, it would be he who would be fleeing desperately now.

In dealing with enemies, Lin Yuan always eradicated them root and branch, and regarding the innocent? As long as they were True Gods, they had all climbed atop countless commoners’ corpses, what hadn’t they done to gather faith?

The Mother Goddess of Lust established the Lust Church, tempting those high officials and nobles with carnal delights, but were those beautiful young women who seduced the high and mighty somehow deserving of their fate?

In the eyes of the gods and the Prime Gods, beings were fodder to raise them, mere ants, just dust, as long as they didn’t kill too many at a time, affecting the supply of faith, they had no scruples whatsoever.

Now, regarding the gods and the Prime Gods as ants was in no way improper for Lin Yuan.

“Longshan Patriarch, as long as you let me go, I have the secrets of the Supreme God to tell you,” sensing Lin Yuan drawing ever closer, the Prime God of Light immediately called out loudly.
